name: vcs-workflow-skill
description: Portable version-control workflow skill for AI coding agents on clients without a per-prompt hook (Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Windsurf, Cline, etc.). Loads once at session start with a checklist for evaluating change scope and pushing to the active branch's own upstream. For Claude Code, install the per-prompt `vcs-workflow` plugin instead — it re-injects the same checklist every turn.
